gecko.visible_surface_condition: Smooth, flat, clean printed carton surface
evidence_used: Visual appearance of a relatively small, lightweight rectangular cardboard box (Mold Release Spray container)
Flat, smooth cardboard sidewalls providing high-compatibility contact for gecko-inspired dry adhesive pads
No authoritative mass, roughness, or contact measurements available
gecko.calculation_summary: F_normal = F_base_light_object - F_adhesion_bonus = 2.0 N - 0.8 N = 1.2 N
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Object weight estimated visually to be under 200g
Cardboard surface is dry and free of powdery coatings that would foul dry-adhesive pads
Visual approximation introduces uncertainty regarding exact weight and friction coefficients
gecko.reasoning_trace: The object is a small retail spray can box with smooth, flat paperboard sidewalls, which offers excellent conditions for dry-adhesive pads to form high-integrity broad contact. Because gecko adhesion significantly assists lifting on smooth, flat surfaces, a relatively low normal force is required to maintain a secure grasp. We estimate 1.2 N based on visual scale and favorable surface compatibility.

silicone.visible_surface_condition: Smooth, flat, clean printed carton surface
evidence_used: Visual appearance of a small rectangular cardboard box
High-friction silicone pads relying on normal force and friction rather than dry adhesion
No authoritative mass, roughness, or contact measurements available
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Object weight estimated visually to be under 200g
Silicone pads provide reliable friction against the printed cardboard surface
Visual approximation introduces uncertainty regarding exact weight and friction coefficients
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies primarily on normal force and frictional resistance to lift the object. Although the smooth cardboard box provides adequate contact, the absence of dry-adhesion benefits means a slightly higher normal force is required compared to the gecko gripper to overcome gravity securely. We estimate 2.2 N.

comparison_evidence: Object sidewalls are visibly flat, smooth, and clean, creating an ideal substrate for gecko-inspired dry-adhesive pads
Gecko adhesion exploits surface proximity to reduce the required stationary-finger normal force compared to purely frictional silicone gripping
recommendation_summary: Both grippers are fully capable of grasping the cardboard box. The gecko gripper is recommended because its dry-adhesive pads form superior broad contact on the smooth, flat carton surfaces, enabling a lower required normal force (1.2 N vs 2.2 N for silicone).
